hub.speaker: Ksmvr
hub.text: I am Ksmvr. I am the third member of the Horns of Hammerad. Three is a defensible number. I proposed a fourth: the [Necromancer] who reads our doors. Captain Ceria says he is hired, not ours, and that a person who invoices you is not a teammate. I have written this down.

text_variants.text: The construct was very large. I stabbed it anyway. Captain Ceria says this is called 'initiative.'
